title: Dura-Europos Church

buildingCutout.basis: Use the excavated M8-A church outline alone for the historical reconstruction.

terrainReference.basis: Original relief elevation immediately outside the north side of the surveyed house.

mapIdentity.provider: 2008 archaeological total-station and photogrammetric survey of M8-A, Pleiades 888638007. The named OpenStreetMap point corroborates identity.
mapIdentity.scope: The 2008 total-station and photogrammetric survey in Pleiades 888638007 sets the excavated 15-point outline and its street orientation. The nearby named OpenStreetMap point corroborates the identity, independently of the surveyed outline used for placement.

note: The Yale–French excavations and recent archaeology establish a mudbrick courtyard building, long converted southern assembly room, western baptistery and west-wall font with plaster canopy, roof stair, flat timber-and-earth roofs and a low attic over the baptistery.
